newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DLR DRIFTS TO MIXED CLOSE ON KEY UNITS.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DLR DRIFTS TO MIXED CLOSE ON KEY UNITS.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar drifted quietly to close Tuesday's session softer on the U.S. dollar and sterling but somewhat firmer on the mark.
Foreign exchange dealers said the central bank came into the market when the dollar went down to 11.2675 on the U.S. unit earlier in the day on the back of some buying by big merchant banks.

"We saw the central bank selling a couple of dollars in the market to try and stabilise the rates at current levels. Later trade was more on the quiet side with not much import pressure," one dealer said.
The local dollar ended at 11.2550/2650 on the U.S. currency from 11.2400/2500 at Monday's close and at 18.2590/2865 on sterling versus 18.2500/2700.
It firmed slightly to 6.5631/5723 on the mark from 6.5800/5900 and to 2.5381/5420 on the rand compared to 2.5400/5600.
